messages:
Maya B: Quick sync: proposing a slim nav IA to reduce cognitive load. Top-level zones = Overview | Registry | Admin. Within Registry, tabs become nested routes (models, datasets, lineage). Prototype: https://figma.com/s/console-slim-nav. Comments?

Connor L: Love the simplification. Question: permalink contract — should we map zones to path segments (`/p/:proj/registry/models`) or keep old query/hash approach for now? Path seems best for sharing.

Priya S: Strong +1 for path segments. Accessibility: when deep-linking into `/p/:proj/registry/models` we must: 1) move focus to H1, 2) announce zone change via polite live region, 3) ensure active nav item has `aria-current="page"`.

Ethan W: Implementation note: we can normalize legacy `?zone=` and `#zone=` links on first render with `history.replaceState` -> canonical path. Emit a telemetry event `nav.rewrite` so product can monitor impacts.

Maya B: Copy micro decisions: nav label = "Model Registry" full-width, short label = "Registry" in compact mode. Breadcrumb root = "Projects". Compact breadcrumb should collapse middle crumbs into an accessible menu.

a11y-bot: Reminder: add `role=\"navigation\" aria-label=\"Primary console navigation\"` and a skip link target `#main-content`. For collapsed crumbs, ensure the expand control is reachable by keyboard and announces "expanded"/"collapsed" via `aria-expanded`.

Connor L: Edge-case: if we replaceState from legacy hash, the back button may no longer return to the hash. Plan: use `replaceState` for silent normalization but also track the legacy URL in telemetry; if users come via legacy links frequently, we can fallback to `pushState` to preserve history.

Priya S: Keyboard interactions: when a nav group is focused, Enter opens it and focus should move to the first focusable element in the main region. When collapsing groups, use `aria-expanded` on the group button and update sr-only text: ", collapsed" or ", expanded".

Ethan W: Tech checklist: router support for `/zone/:zoneSlug/*`, parser for legacy `?zone=`/`#zone=`, normalization with `nav.rewrite` telemetry, unit + e2e tests for focus + history + analytics dedupe. Collapse state persisted in sessionStorage only.

Maya B: UX polish: add faint separators between zones and a small group label (non-clickable). Use the same accent token for focus rings as global tokens. Also provide a small tooltip on hover for compact labels.

ops-bot: Ops note: backend routes should accept both `/p/:proj/zone/:zoneSlug/*` and legacy `/p/:proj` with query/hash for short-term compatibility. Recommend enabling a 2-week redirect monitoring window.

Priya S: Accessibility QA: include tests for screen-reader announcement on deep-link, keyboard nav through crumb collapse menu, and verifying `aria-current` on active item. Also check color contrast for separators (>= 2:1 if decorative, >= 3:1 if interactive).

Maya B: Action items: Maya update Figma with the final copy + compact tooltip text; Ethan draft the router parser + normalization PR; Priya prepare a11y checklist and QA cases; Connor coordinate backend redirect window. I'll post the canonical URL spec here when it's ready. Thanks folks :sparkles:
